name: MolViBench
description: MolViBench is a molecular vibe coding benchmark containing 358 bilingual (Chinese/English) programming tasks across 5 difficulty levels for evaluating LLMs on generating executable RDKit-based code from natural-language chemistry tasks. Tasks span molecular property calculation, structural transformation, chemical reasoning, multi-step inference, and end-to-end molecular discovery pipelines.
